body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). The Anup Engineering (ANUP). Probability 0.64 (naive sector base rate 0.54) that: The Anup Engineering (ANUP) FY27 consolidated EBITDA >= Rs 114 cr (95% of Rs 120 cr). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.538 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'margin', n=26); SAC +0.437 x w 0.231 (N=6) -> P_cred = 0.64. Evidence: call of 2026-11-06: "with an EBITDA in the range of INR120 crores to INR128 crores" (Q2FY27). Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated operating profit (revenue - operating expenses, excl. other income) >= Rs 114 cr. Source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.538 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'margin', n=26); SAC +0.437 x w 0.231 (N=6) -> P_cred = 0.64
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Capital Goods peers in group 'margin' (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'margin', n=26). No company-specific information.
data.promise_quote: "with an EBITDA in the range of INR120 crores to INR128 crores" (Q2FY27)
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 consolidated operating profit (revenue - operating expenses, excl. other income) >= Rs 114 cr.
data.resolution_source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE)

title: Paper call: The Anup Engineering (ANUP) FY27 consolidated EBITDA >= Rs 114 cr (95% of Rs 120 cr)
